learning_cards_builtin_scope_check.name: learning_cards_builtin_scope_check
learning_cards_builtin_scope_check.value:
(
        ("learning_cards"."source" = 'builtin' and "learning_cards"."family_id" is null and "learning_cards"."builtin_key" is not null)
        or
        ("learning_cards"."source" <> 'builtin' and "learning_cards"."family_id" is not null and "learning_cards"."builtin_key" is null)
      )

review_events_relearning_source_check.name: review_events_relearning_source_check
review_events_relearning_source_check.value:
(
        ("review_events"."event_type" = 'same_session_relearning' and "review_events"."source_review_event_id" is not null)
        or
        ("review_events"."event_type" <> 'same_session_relearning' and "review_events"."source_review_event_id" is null)
      )
